column3: “For” is rendered “When,” and NASB adds “then”; “the sojourner” is plural, “strangers.”
“Labor which was labored by you” is rendered “service in which you have been enslaved.”
“Fir trees” is rendered “cypress trees,” and NASB supplies “saying.”
“Shades” is rendered “the spirits of the dead.”
“Shining one” (helel) is rendered “star of the morning,” and “defeater” as “who have weakened.”
“You have been brought down” is rendered in the future, “will be thrust down.”
“Not he opened home” is rendered “did not allow … to go home.”
“House” is rendered “tomb,” and “in splendor” as “in glory.”
“Land” is rendered “country,” and “will not be named” as the wish “May … not be mentioned.”
“Firstborn of the poor” is rendered “those who are most helpless,” and “graze” as “eat.”
